function.primary: combined sand/silt separation and downstream three-dimensional disc filtration

hydraulic.pressure_drop_note: Manufacturer provides clean pressure-drop curves by size and flow; design must use actual operating flow rather than treating filter loss as zero.

application.manufacturer_example: micro-irrigation removal of sand and silt particles from irrigation water

consider_when: water carries both heavier mineral particles and finer contaminants
a compact combined separation/filtration arrangement is useful
do_not_assume: that a combined filter is automatically better or cheaper for a small clean-water job
that filter pressure loss is negligible
that nominal filter flow equals the actual design flow
that the filtration grade required by the chosen emitters is satisfied without verifying the disc specification
ask_or_compare: capital cost versus simpler staged filters
